summary: Test drives the real parser on 5 markdown fixtures; mutation-verified that each conjunct has its own killer: deleting the per-heading grammar push fails the new malformedAfterValid case (valid REQ-001.1 + '### REQ-001.2 Advanced' with sections=['REQ-001.1'], so the zero-sections fallback cannot mask it), making the colon optional fails the missingColon case, disabling the sections.length===0 fallback fails the prose-only case, and dropping the missing-'## Requirements' push fails the noHeading case; VALID spec asserts no violations as the false-positive control.
